hypotheses: CONDITIONAL PREREGISTRATION SKELETON; NOT SELECTED — AT-HYP-0005, NO_EDGE/PASS. Why consider it: a tightly bounded paired comparison could test whether abstention adds economic value without an architecture sweep. Minimum test: replay one already-specified deterministic strategy against the identical strategy with one already-defined, immutable abstention rule; do not invent or tune that rule from these results. Baseline: identical eligibility, clock, exposure accounting and cost model, with the abstention rule disabled. Required data: PIT inputs, complete eligible-decision records, outcome paths and defensible executable-cost evidence; these are not supplied. Primary comparison: paired net economic value, with turnover, exposure and missed opportunities reported separately. Falsifier: the existing support requirement is not met, or apparent benefit depends on removing costs, changing the gate or excluding suppressed opportunities. Integrity failure makes the test inadmissible, not economically disproved. Forward burden: one paired family; calendar length UNKNOWN. Duplication risk: substantial overlap with AT-HYP-0002 and AT-HYP-0017. Stronger-evidence burden: a genuinely post-registration independent period, stable cost sensitivity and an auditable distinction between avoiding weak events and merely reducing exposure.
summary:
VERDICT=INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; MODEL_USED=gpt-6.1-sol; NO_CODE_WRITE_PERFORMED; NO_AUTHORITY_CHANGE;

EVIDENCE_MACHINE_READINESS: Bounded competence is SUPPORTED for the supplied E1 controls and AT-HYP-0019 lineage. General cleanliness and readiness to allocate new economic forward tests are UNKNOWN. The checkpoint's selective-readiness conclusion is plausible but stronger than the independently reviewable evidence. This is not a finding that every source is unusable.

BLOCKING_DEFECTS: Cross-hypothesis attempt-accounting coverage is unproven; candidate-specific PIT inputs, immutable baseline rules and execution-cost evidence are missing; source-vintage and revision behavior are incompletely documented. The packet also contains different mission, checkpoint and current-main SHAs without a supplied bridging diff. Those differences do not prove regression, but current readiness cannot be inferred from them. The predecessor-release receipt is absent; this review does not change queue or mission state.

HYPOTHESIS_RANKING: No evidence-backed numerical value-of-information ranking is possible. A conditional design-burden ordering is: (1) AT-HYP-0005, because one fixed abstention comparison could expose turnover and missed-opportunity costs; (2) AT-HYP-0017, because a single fixed maximum-hold comparison is deterministic but needs position paths and capital-reuse accounting; (3) AT-HYP-0016, because a fixed regime ablation has a clear redundancy falsifier, although it overlaps strongly with AT-HYP-0002 and requires vintage-safe regime outputs. This ordering describes potentially economical test designs, not demonstrated data availability or expected profitability.

SELECTED_CANDIDATES_MAX_3: None. Analytical disposition: BUILD_NOTHING for new forward tests on this packet. This is neither a repository change nor a permanent rejection of the mission hypothesis.

REJECTED_CANDIDATES: AT-HYP-0019 is excluded from immediate retesting because the supplied design failed and no genuinely new basis is shown. Other candidates are deferred, not scientifically rejected: 0002 overlaps with 0016; 0003/0004/0008 require broad architecture comparisons; 0006 requires execution evidence not supplied; 0011/0013/0014 introduce substantial feature or rule multiplicity; 0015 requires position-level DCA accounting; 0018/0020 require matched MAEVE actions, controls and version information; 0021/0022 require independent observer records, labeled outcomes, latency and compute costs. Process hypotheses 0001/0007/0009/0010/0012 require comparative process evidence and should not be counted as established economic edge.

POWER_AND_FORWARD_SLOT_BUDGET: No forward test is selected; no actual budget is changed. N5 has 108 nominal OOS rows, 54 per symbol, across roughly ten calendar days. Shared market exposure and overlapping 24-hour outcomes prevent treating these as 108 independent observations. Effective sample size, power, minimum detectable economic effect and required forward duration are UNKNOWN. N1 controls, N3 replay and blocked N4 are not additional independent alpha evidence. Related comparisons must retain shared-family multiplicity rather than become independent free attempts.

PREREGISTRATION_SKELETONS: The AT-HYP-0005 template below is conditional and incomplete until its existing rule and data are identified. For 0017, the corresponding bounded template would compare an unchanged existing exit policy with one pre-existing fixed maximum-hold policy, measuring paired net expectancy, capital occupancy and delayed-winner losses; no hold duration or capital-reuse benefit can be filled in from this packet. For 0016, it would compare frozen asset-only outputs with a frozen global-plus-asset mapping, using identical downstream evaluation and testing incremental value beyond duplicated momentum/volatility information. No regime thresholds, weights or consumption rules are supplied, so neither skeleton constitutes an initiated test. All templates need immutable family/attempt identity, source and knowledge-time bindings, multiplicity treatment, a pre-outcome endpoint and support requirement, failed-attempt retention, and no post-result substitutions.

STRONGEST_FALSIFICATION: The baseline assumes PIT safety and immutable trial accounting; the packet supports those only locally. It does not demonstrate that any new economic hypothesis meets readiness and opportunity-cost requirements. The most concrete economic caution is N5: large relative IC improvement over a negative baseline still yields zero transforms passing the frozen positive-OOS gate.

DECISION DIVERGENCE AND COSTS: The reproducible divergence is the 3-of-3 N5 gate comparison described above. Actual decision-level disagreement, false-positive economic loss and false-negative missed-opportunity cost are UNKNOWN because decision records and executable counterfactual outcomes are absent. The frozen gate avoids three unsupported transform acceptance labels under the relative-improvement proxy; that is not a monetary benefit estimate or proof of three statistical false discoveries. Incremental causal value of the research machine versus the stated baseline is also UNKNOWN because that baseline already includes its controls and there is no comparative process experiment.

MINIMUM NEXT ACTION: No empirical allocation is warranted from this packet. The minimum missing evidence is a read-only demonstration that one existing candidate has a complete PIT/source-vintage contract, frozen baseline and cost model, cross-family attempt coverage, overlap assessment and feasible power plan. No new theory, execution layer, write, promotion or authority change is requested.
